name: shipped
description: The recipe that produced models/full.* and models/tiny.* (2026-09-01, RTX 4070). Plain-L1 runs of 40k steps, then an 8k-step fine-tune with the block-mean consistency term; the fine-tunes ship.

full.note: plain L1; 62 min; 31.72 dB fixed-set; Water World drifts 12 levels

full-mc.note: SHIPPED as models/full: + block-mean consistency; 30.48 dB fixed-set, Water World 0.96 levels

tiny-mc.note: SHIPPED as models/tiny: + block-mean consistency; 29.79 dB fixed-set

full-ft.note: vivid-saturation push in augmentation: no effect on the water drift. Not shipped.

tiny-ft.note: same push on the tiny model: slightly worse (10.4 -> 12.2 levels on Water World). Not shipped.
